title: Paradise Found | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located in the exclusive, gated community of Dunes of Destin, this stunning vacation home blends modern coastal luxury with resort-style amenities, all just steps from the Gulf. Designed to accommodate up to 24 guests, it features a private pool with spa, rooftop patio with panoramic ocean views, and an in-home elevator connecting all three floors. Inside, warm hardwoods, white shiplap walls, and chic finishes create a relaxed yet refined atmosphere, while the spacious layout includes multiple gathering areas and a designer kitchen outfitted with quartz counters and stainless appliances—ideal for entertaining family and friends. Every home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests stay. We provide a starter set of laundry detergent for our guests to use when they arrive.
